assessment_limits: Inspected all 33 recovered candidate frames. Timestamps follow the supplied 2.5-second sampling convention; some pictured scenes differ from the stated timeline. Temporal flicker and continuous motion were not verified. CINEMATOGRAPHY.md was not found.

issues.evidence: The enlarged 'Slide 2 · TextBox 23', accept/reject icons and '10 of 10 changes accepted' have visibly soft edges, while the overlaid captions remain sharp.
issues.suggested_action: Recapture the real review panel at higher resolution with increased application zoom, then frame it without enlarging low-resolution pixels.

issues.evidence: Maya's reaction close-ups show smoothed, waxy facial detail and glassy eyes; her facial proportions and blouse neckline also differ between the earlier desk shot and the reviewing shot.
issues.suggested_action: Replace these reactions with footage using one consistent performer or identity reference, preserving skin texture, wardrobe and matching eye-line.

issues.evidence: The request, memo and Changes panel appear as large rectangular crops over a nearly black blurred office; slight perspective does not establish a physical display or a finished graphic environment.
issues.suggested_action: Use one coherent presentation system: matched laptop inserts for physical scenes and crisp, deliberately composed full-frame app views for product detail.

issues.evidence: The repeated shoulder view contains an unusually black, clean screen plane with little visible reflection; the inserted UI has a different texture from the surrounding laptop and actor.
issues.suggested_action: Match screen exposure, reflections, lens softness and grain to the plate, and verify screen tracking throughout each moving shot.

issues.evidence: Three outlined status tiles, oversized white message rectangles and a centered chart with a red ellipse dominate the frame like presentation slides.
issues.suggested_action: Reduce graphic chrome, establish a consistent type hierarchy and connect the messages to a visible phone or a purposefully designed messaging treatment.

issues.evidence: The dawn laptop shows a dark application rectangle inset inside a bright white display, making the app look pasted into a second screen.
issues.suggested_action: Fit the real app capture to the laptop's active display and match its perspective, brightness and reflections.

issues.evidence: David is centered against soft city windows, holding a document and giving a restrained approving expression; the frame lacks the environmental specificity and incidental behavior of the Codex reference.
issues.suggested_action: Show approval within a wider boardroom interaction, with motivated eye-lines and other participants rather than an isolated portrait.

issues.evidence: The reveal uses several centered text lines over an empty office; the ending stacks the feature, product, sentence, pill CTA and disclaimer, with 'one.' wrapping onto its own line.
issues.suggested_action: Refine the lockup and line breaks, shorten the supporting copy and give the product name and CTA clearer visual priority.

constraint_failures.evidence: The mean of 33 frame scores is 5.06/10, yielding a real_film_index of 50.61.
